notes.title: A few hotfixes, and testing better a theorically collision detection
notes.content:
- Fix powerup effects being given to only one player
- Fix some bug where death effects would have improper positionning
- Fix a bug that would make killscreens with physics objects behave improperly (fixes Blackhole)
- Fix the camera scaling not being the same with different level zooms
- Slightly enlarge the 'Eater' killscreen
- Slow objects in 'Spawner11'

I now use continuous CD (collision detection) on props and some other physics objects, this should make the game run slightly slower (theorically, but I didn't notice it yet), but make collision detection slightly better. On that note:

- Nerf deagle/kalashnikov bullets since collision detection was buffed


Also the game should now have a proper Nintendo Switch Pro Controller config

notes.title: Bugfixes and new stuff
notes.content:
It is now possible to make levels with a different camera zoom. This permits to have bigger levels.
Backgrounds, Killscreens and Powerups are not scaled, Events aren't either, but it's not forced.
A few levels were added to showcase this new feature.

- Add some more levels
- Remove CRT option, bring it back in an event with a better look (Pixelize)
- Add a bit of audio processing for some events (Pixelize, Wind, Tsunami, LowGravity)
- Change a lot of powerup visuals to fix physics interpolation, accidentally making some of them better (Revert, HighJump, Sleep, Freeze)
- Put back Godot Input for emotes on triggers (for controllers)
- Fix some many minor bugs
- Lots of tweaks here and there

Also, the API was updated

notes.title: Bugfixes, gameplay content, tweaks and save
notes.content:
The game should now save your progress on the cloud, so you can have a backup when moving to another PC, or re-installing the game.

Twitch


 New potential vote: "Which player would you help" (gives 5 point to the most voted player)
 Change the random pick animation from a random sequence to a more "roulette" style animation
 Launch events instantly on pick, not on the next round


Bugfixes


 Probably fix threaded loading of game parts, thus fixing deadlocks (note the 'probably')
 Fix some collision sounds not triggering
 Fix some sounds attenuation/freeing issues
 Enhance hit detection a tiny bit for contact props (Basketball, Cross, Crate, Football, Rugby)
 Add some forgotten translations


Gameplay


 New event: SuperProp
 Crate now works with a charge jump
 Bazooka can now slightly control the missile direction
 Slightly lower Bazooka power
 GrenadeLauncher bullets now explode each other when close to each other
 Jump buffering has been added for Crate, Football, Fridge, GloveBox, Rugby, Toaster
 Change event modifier values (in the menu)


Modding


 'util' isn't a loaded node anymore, all its functions are now static
 game.time_scale variable to change time scale
 game.event_new_round signal triggered on each new round (useful for events)

notes.title: Twitch hotfix
notes.content:
Changed Twitch authentification method from "Implicit Flow" to "Device Code".

This requires slightly more steps but will cause less issues with different systems and remote play focus

notes.title: Twitch integration, color updates and more
notes.content:
Some cool changes coming in, some less, probably new bugs, who knows? This update hasn't been tested a lot so as always if you encounter bugs, please report them in our discord server.

Chinese translation hasn't been updated in time and it's entirely my fault. It will be updated when it can.

Anyways, here's a quick overview of the changes


Twitch integration

The game should now permit Twitch integration (go to Game Settings > Twitch).
This will change the event system to only work with votes. The Twitch chat will be able to vote for the next events they want, and you can set the voting time.

Gameplay

A few workshop addons were added to the base game
- Fog event
- Wind event
- Freeze powerup

- A few arenas were added to the game
- Added a hard limit of 16 to the x2 powerup (so this doesn't happen anymore) https://youtu.be/qaR-x7vMiFY


Graphics

- Player colors were all changed to be a bit better looking and less eye hurting
- A few backgrounds were adjusted to be a bit better looking in terms of colors too
- A slight vignette effect was added on the background layer to make it a bit smoother
- The crate texture was remade (hype!)


Engine

The Godot Engine version was bumped from 4.3 to 4.4.1, this should enhance performance a bit but might trigger some new bugs.
The game now also triggers a bunch of not important errors too, but that will only be a tiny issue for mod makers.

There was a lot of code cleanup and fixes, mainly to solve problems due to changing the Godot Engine version, but also to try to fix pre-existing bugs that were just silent or whatever.

notes.title: Nobody asked for it... yet
notes.content:
Nobody asked for it (yet), but here it is, the colorblind mode option!

notes.title: Mic check 1-2...Is this working?
notes.content:
Thanks everyone who bought the game or got a key offered by some generous donator.

The game got released last week and we're already fixing some things over time, don't hesitate to report bugs you encounter on steam forums or on the official discord server!

The OST will soon be available on Steam but you can already listen to it on Spotify, Youtube or some other streaming platforms.

What's planned?

Not much is planned for now except Twitch integration which is being worked on. I'm planning to work on enhancing the modding support and make a better documentation. On that note...

Looking for modders

The game heavily focuses on making mods and right now I'm the only user of my tools so I don't really know what's missing/needed to add to the documentation. I'm open to questions and suggestions regarding modding and the documentation, so don't hesitate to ask something, even if it you think it sounds dumb, it's probably not.
